# NAHB Connect

> > NAHB Connect is the online community platform for National Association of Home Builders members to network, participate in forums, and access industry events like the International Builders' Show.

NAHB Connect serves as the central hub for home building professionals to engage with NAHB communities, find resources, and stay informed about industry announcements. The platform facilitates member collaboration and provides access to key events including IBS in Las Vegas and NAHB leadership conferences.

## Key Topics

- NAHB (National Association of Home Builders)
- International Builders' Show (IBS)
- NAHB Connect community platform
- Home building industry
- HBA (Home Builders Association)
- Best of IBS Awards
- Member networking and forums
- NAHB leadership events
- Community guidelines and code of conduct
- Housing industry advocacy
- Builder community announcements
- Industry conferences and meetings
- Member authentication and registration

## Community Portal

- [Home - National Association of Home Builders](https://connect.nahb.org/home): NAHB Connect homepage featuring IBS and community announcements
- [Community Home - National Association of Home Builders](https://connect.nahb.org/communities/community-home): Member community portal with IBS updates and industry announcements
- [Announcements - National Association of Home Builders](https://connect.nahb.org/browse/announcements): NAHB Connect announcements page for member community updates
- [In Search Of.. - National Association of Home Builders](https://connect.nahb.org/browse/in-search-of): Member directory and search forum for NAHB Connect community
- [Home - Super Forum Thrive Site](https://connect.nahb.org/superforumthrivesite/home): Super Forum Thrive Site homepage for housing industry professionals

## Events and Meetings

- [Meetings | NAHB](https://connect.nahb.org/thrivesite/nahb-events): NAHB meetings including Spring Leadership and Legislative Conference

## Industry Advocacy and Updates

- [National Association of Home Builders | NAHB](https://connect.nahb.org/new-item1): Housing advocacy updates including ROAD Act and HUD energy code mandates

## Member Access and Authentication

- [Login | NAHB - Network](https://connect.nahb.org/network): Network login and authentication page for NAHB members
- [Login | NAHB - Participate](https://connect.nahb.org/participate): Member participation login and registration page
- [Login | NAHB - Join Community](https://connect.nahb.org/participate/join-community): Community membership authentication and registration portal
- [Login | NAHB - Thrive Network](https://connect.nahb.org/thrivesite/network): Thrive site network login and authentication portal

## Community Guidelines and Support

- [NAHB Connect Guidelines - National Association of Home Builders](https://connect.nahb.org/guidelines): NAHB Connect posting rules and forum etiquette for members
- [Code of Conduct - National Association of Home Builders (old site)](https://connect.nahb.org/oldsite/codeofconduct): Community guidelines and antitrust compliance rules for member forums
- [Contact Us - National Association of Home Builders (old site)](https://connect.nahb.org/oldsite/contactus): Old site contact and support information for HBA Connect
